Game Overview

In Mini Huggy - 2 Players, the core idea is straightforward: race against your friend in the adorable world of Mini Huggy. Navigate colorful, dynamic tracks full of fun challenges using simple controls. Speed, agility, and a bit of strategy will help you dodge obstacles and collect treasures as you sprint toward victory. Embrace the fluff-filled competition!
